item.title: Buy enough tickets for a boat ride
item.context_text: One adult and two children want a short boat ride. You have ten pounds and a card.
item.objective_text: Work out the cost and arrange the group’s tickets.
success_conditions: Work out the cost and arrange the group’s tickets.

children.title: Read the boat notice
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Adults: six pounds. Children: three pounds. The boat leaves at eleven and twelve. Pay at the desk by the river.

questions.prompt: What is the cost for two children?
questions.explanation: Two children at three pounds each cost six pounds.

options: At the desk by the river
questions.explanation: The desk beside the river sells tickets.

children.title: Hear the ticket seller
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: The eleven o’clock boat is full, but the twelve o’clock boat has room. We can take cards and cash, but please use one way to pay.

questions.explanation: The seller says the eleven o’clock boat is full.

questions.prompt: Can you pay part in cash and part by card?
options: No, choose one way to pay
Yes, if you buy one ticket
questions.explanation: The seller asks for one way to pay.

children.title: Ask the seller for tickets
children.prompt_text: You are ready to buy the tickets and you have your card.
children.instructions: Name the time, who is travelling, and how you want to pay. Check that you can say the numbers clearly.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Three tickets for the twelve o’clock boat, please. One adult and two children. Can I pay by card? Do we get on here?

points.label: State the group size
any: one adult and two child tickets

children.title: Send a message to the children’s parent
children.prompt_text: Tell the parent the new time and where to meet. Explain why you used the card and how much you paid.
children.instructions: Give the facts before adding a friendly closing. Check that the parent can find you using only the message.
children.goal: Work out the cost and arrange the group’s tickets.
children.model_answer: The eleven o’clock boat is full, so we are taking the boat at noon. Meet us by the desk at the river. The three tickets cost twelve pounds. I only had ten pounds in cash, so I paid by card.
